status_sections.Summary: Unagi 21.0.4 is Red, and the single biggest risk is the open blocker SPEC-5757 on that release. Across the program, there are 179 open issues, 33 new in the last 30 days, 17 resolved in the last 30 days, and 24 open blockers/criticals.
status_sections.Risks & slips:
- SPEC-5757 is the only open issue on Unagi 21.0.4; it is a blocker and keeps the release Red.
- SPEC-5625, SPEC-5700, SPEC-5701, SPEC-5705, SPEC-5713, SPEC-5734, SPEC-5740, SPEC-5741, SPEC-5747, and SPEC-5758 are open blocker/critical items with no assignee.
- SPEC-4693, SPEC-4963, SPEC-5487, SPEC-5444, SPEC-5468, SPEC-5483, SPEC-5561, SPEC-5687, SPEC-5719, and SPEC-5754 are open blocker items that are already escalated.
- SPEC-5375 is an open critical item and is escalated.
- Hygiene remains weak: 173 issues have no fix version, 113 have no component, 56 have no assignee, and 149 are stale.
status_sections.Asks / decisions needed:
- Assign owners to SPEC-5625, SPEC-5700, SPEC-5701, SPEC-5705, SPEC-5713, SPEC-5734, SPEC-5740, SPEC-5741, SPEC-5747, and SPEC-5758.
- Confirm priority and next action for SPEC-5757 so Unagi 21.0.4 can move off Red.
- Review whether SPEC-4693, SPEC-4963, SPEC-5487, SPEC-5444, SPEC-5468, SPEC-5483, SPEC-5561, SPEC-5687, SPEC-5719, SPEC-5754, and SPEC-5375 need program-level escalation or schedule adjustment.
status_sections.Next steps:
- Work the open blocker/critical set first, starting with the escalated items.
- Triage the 10 unassigned blocker/critical issues and assign owners.
- Clean up issue hygiene for no fix version, no component, no assignee, and stale items.
- Track progress on Vimba 22.0.0 and master, which are Green with 2 and 5 open issues respectively.
